name: TrustyData
description:
TrustyData connects Claude to authoritative French geographic and company data,
sourced from official open referentials and kept up to date.

Addresses — Verify an address against the official Base Adresse Nationale (BAN)
and get a verdict plus the canonical address, already split into ready-to-write
postal lines. Search addresses and communes by name, postal code or INSEE code,
filter communes by department, region or population, and find addresses within a
radius of any point.

Companies — Look up French businesses and establishments in the SIRENE register
(INSEE) by name, SIREN, SIRET, location or activity code, then open a full
record: identity, activity, workforce, collective agreements, company officers
(INPI), financials.

Catchment areas — Describe a zone as a drive, walk or cycle time, or as a radius,
and get what INSEE knows about the people living there: population, households,
average standard of living, age profile, housing, socio-professional categories
and estimated disposable income. Compare 2 to 10 zones in a single call and
measure how much they overlap.

Routing — Compute a road route, or a travel-time and distance matrix, across
France (OpenStreetMap), by car, on foot or by bike.

All eleven tools are read-only: nothing is created, modified or deleted. Results
are authoritative — an empty result means no match, never a gap to fill in. The
API answers one address per call and is designed to be driven from a script or an
ETL pipeline for larger workloads.

Requires a TrustyData account. The free Discovery plan covers address and company
lookups; proximity search and catchment statistics require Growth; routing and
INSEE grid enrichment require Business.

Sources: BAN and IGN (addresses, IRIS contours), INSEE (communes, Filosofi,
census, SIRENE), INPI (company officers), OpenStreetMap under ODbL (routing).

_published_faq.name: How do I add TrustyData to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TrustyData to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.trustydata.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TrustyData MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TrustyData provides these MCP tools: compute_route, get_address_details, get_company_details, route_matrix, search_address, search_company, search_locality, search_nearby, verify_address, zone_compare, and zone_stats.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TrustyData?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to TrustyData in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
TrustyData requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TrustyData is developed by Tristram Hervé. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
